**What are you proposing?**
A clear description of the change.

**Why does this belong in the template?**
Quin is a *template*, not a kernel — new features should teach a generally
applicable concept, not add project-specific functionality. Explain why this
belongs here rather than in a downstream fork.

**Scope check**
- [ ] This targets x86_64 + QEMU (the template's only supported platform)
- [ ] This doesn't require a hand-built GCC cross-compiler
- [ ] This has a clear point in the phase roadmap (`docs/ROADMAP.md`) or justifies a new one

**Alternatives considered**
